item.title: Re: Complete Desolation
item.content:encoded:
The obvious problem you have is that it's based on a tac-nuke; while it's always fun to go into what a tac-nuke can do, they are just unlikely to target something small enough to be taken out with one. Upgrading it just creates bigger problems. You'd do better with an epidemic or invasion, which have been known to take out towns.

It would also be harder to keep the city out of the news.

It is worth noting that experimentation would be able to determine if he is truly schizophrenic or is actually talking to ghosts; The Foundation would be able to determine that. If he truly is talking to ghosts, then The Foundation would have specialists that would love to talk to him. If he's merely schizophrenic, The Foundation getting him help would make for some interesting debates similar to whether or not he could leave the town.

Otherwise, an excellent start. It should be interesting to see where this goes.

item.title: Complete Desolation
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Genre (Optional): Drama/Emotional

Elevator Pitch: A city thought to be destroyed by a tactical nuke is completely intact and functioning normally With one heat signature

Central Narrative: The heat signature is from a man that when researched can be found on file from [DATA REDACTED], Japan. He doesn’t seem aware that a nuke hit said city and lives in it agelessly

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The man has been shown to be talking to unknown people in the city in trivial conversation. It is unknown whether he is talking to an anomalous affect or is a schizophrenic. However when going to place of residence he shows signs of depression, possibly showing sapience to his situation.

Additional Notes: When the man goes to the edges of the city large tremors happen around him. It is unknown if him leaving will result in his neutralization. To counteract this he is forced by the foundation to stay in the inner area of the city until more information is found.
